solution.title: Phased GPO-to-Intune Transition Program & Sequencing Roadmap

products.name: Phased GPO-to-Intune Transition Program & Sequencing Roadmap — Commercial
products.short_description: The program and sequencing roadmap for a GPO-to-Intune transition done right — core OS first, then security controls, with coexistence governance, conflict/loop guardrails, and go/no-go gates. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Do it right: a sequenced GPO-to-Intune transition that stabilizes the foundation before touching security

The fastest way to break a GPO-to-Intune transition is to migrate security controls (firewall, app control) before the foundation is clean — conflicts, loops, and lockouts follow. This solution is the program and sequencing roadmap for doing it right: migrate core OS settings first, stabilize, then layer in security controls in a deliberate order, with coexistence governance (MDM-wins-over-GP), conflict/loop guardrails, go/no-go gates, and an operating model — so internal pressure to rush doesn't wreck the move.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the phased transition model (rationalize → core OS → stabilize → security controls → app control), coexistence and precedence (MDM wins over GP), conflict/loop governance, and the program operating model with go/no-go gates.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, a rationalized GPO backlog, Group Policy analytics, stakeholder alignment, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define phases and sequencing, set coexistence/precedence guardrails, run the core-OS phase, stabilize and validate, sequence the security-control phases (firewall, app control) with go/no-go gates, then expand and decommission GPO scope.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — transition-readiness discovery, per-phase coexistence/conflict validation, a phase-status and conflict report, safe remediation of precedence conflicts, and a phase/wave scope-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A GPO-to-Intune transition that holds together — core OS migrated and stabilized first, security controls sequenced behind go/no-go gates, conflicts and loops governed — so internal pressure to rush doesn't break the move, proven on a pilot phase before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GPOPROG-Discovery.ps1 — transition readiness for a phased GPO-to-Intune program
    • GPOPROG-Remediation.ps1 — safely resolve a precedence conflict (-WhatIf default)
    • GPOPROG-Report.ps1 — phase-status and conflict report for the transition program
    • GPOPROG-Set-PhaseScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the phase/wave scope groups in Entra (Graph)
    • GPOPROG-Validation.ps1 — per-phase coexistence/conflict validation on a device

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
